## Version label (required)

Add **exactly one** label before merge:

- `major` — breaking / major user-facing change (`1.0.0` → `2.0.0`)
- `minor` — new feature (`1.0.0` → `1.1.0`)
- `patch` — bugfix / small change (`1.0.0` → `1.0.1`)
- `no-build` — docs/chore only (skip Firebase, Play, and version commit)

See [docs/BUILD_NUMBER.md](docs/BUILD_NUMBER.md).
